parameters.name: Filters
parameters.description:
The filter conditions. Valid values:

- ExpireTimeStart: The start of the time range to query the expiration time of subscription resources.
  ><notice>This parameter applies only to service instances in private deployments.></notice>

- ExpireTimeEnd: The end of the time range to query the expiration time of subscription resources.
  ><notice>This parameter applies only to service instances in private deployments.></notice>

- PayType: The billing method.><notice> This parameter applies only to service instances in private deployments.></notice>
  Valid values:

  - Subscription: subscription.

  - PayAsYouGo: pay-as-you-go.

- ResourceARN: The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the resource.

resource name (ARN).

sub_parameters.name: Name
sub_parameters.description:
The name of the filter. Valid values:

- ExpireTimeStart

- ExpireTimeEnd

- PayType

- ResourceARN

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results. Set this to the NextToken value from a previous API call.

parameters.name: ServiceInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the service instance.

parameters.name: ServiceInstanceResourceType
parameters.description:
The resource type of the service instance. Valid values:

- AliyunResource: an Alibaba Cloud resource.

- ContainerResource: a container group (pod) resource.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The key of the resource tag.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The value of the resource tag.
